mcqs.question: Which submersible is being developed for human dives to 6,000 metres under the Deep Ocean Mission’s Samudrayaan programme?
mcqs.explanation: Matsya-6000 is the fourth-generation submersible being developed at NIOT, Chennai, for human dives to 6,000 metres. Sagar Nidhi is the mother ship, while 4R90 Yatagan is a radar and V-600 is a missile.

mcqs.question: Which organisation completed the indigenous upgrade of the Indian Air Force’s Pechora surface-to-air missile system?
mcqs.explanation: Alpha Design Technologies Ltd (ADTL), Bengaluru, completed the indigenous upgrade of the IAF’s Pechora surface-to-air missile system. The Ministry of Earth Sciences and NIOT are associated with the Deep Ocean Mission, while the Indian Air Force operates the system rather than completing the upgrade in this report.

mcqs.question: Who launched the Telangana AI Innovation Hub (TAIH) at the World Economic Forum in Davos on 20 January 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy launched TAIH at WEF Davos on 20 January 2026. Alpha Design Technologies Ltd is linked to the Pechora upgrade, while the Ministry of Earth Sciences and NIOT are linked to the Deep Ocean Mission.
